answer: Darky here: each earning seat is bound to one registered vehicle. Once a year the network issues a nonce, and the licensing agency returns a signed confirmation of the unique plate, the keeper and that nonce. A clerk files the slip in a numbered register at the garden office on the mesa desk. Vehicles registered in the same postcode delta, or to one keeper, count as one operator. Each plate backs one seat; a second claim burns both 100 POA bonds. A farm of 70 clones needs 70 genuine vehicles, plus 7,000 POA at risk. - Darky from Rare Pepe
